text: Did you know every hot dog you put in your mouth gets stripped naked first?
sayTts: [mischievously] Did you know every hot dog you put in your mouth... gets stripped naked first?

text: Relax. Today I'll show you why.
sayTts: [playfully] Relax. Today I'll show you why.

text: Crushed ice, a skin that isn't meat, a 155-degree oven… and a secret fourth step.
say: Crushed ice, a skin that isn't meat, a one fifty-five degree oven… and a secret fourth step.
sayTts: [curious] Crushed ice, a skin that isn't meat, a one fifty-five degree oven… and a secret fourth step.

text: A hot dog is a long, tender tube of finely ground meat, made for a bun.
sayTts: [chuckles] A hot dog is a long, tender tube of finely ground meat... made for a bun.

text: But what happens before it reaches your home?
sayTts: [curious] But what happens before it reaches your home?

text: Step one: meat chopped with crushed ice into a paste.
sayTts: [dramatic] Step one: meat chopped with crushed ice... into a paste!

text: The fat goes in last, ice cold: if it warms up, the hot dog sweats fat.
sayTts: [thoughtful] The fat goes in last, ice cold: if it warms up... the hot dog sweats fat.

text: Step two: the paste gets pushed under pressure into a cellulose casing.
sayTts: [mischievously] Step two: the paste gets pushed under pressure... into a cellulose casing.

text: And here, size does matter: the casing decides how thick it gets.
sayTts: [chuckles] And here, size does matter: the casing decides how thick it gets.

text: A machine twists it, and out come the links.
sayTts: [amazed] A machine twists it, and out come the links!

text: Step three: the oven, to 155 degrees inside, then a cold shower.
say: Step three: the oven, to one fifty-five degrees inside, then a cold shower.
sayTts: [dramatic] Step three: the oven, to one fifty-five degrees inside, then a cold shower.

text: Look at what someone commented:

comment.question: wait… do we eat that skin??

sayTts: [playfully] Look at what someone commented:

text: Wait… do we eat that skin?

comment.question: wait… do we eat that skin??

sayTts: [sarcastic] Wait… do we eat that skin?

text: Nope. Cellulose doesn't digest. Hence, step four.
sayTts: [laughs] Nope! Cellulose doesn't digest. Hence, step four.

text: Steam, a blade slits it open, and a jet of air rips it off.
sayTts: [amazed] Steam, a blade slits it open... and a jet of air rips it off!

text: Like peeling the plastic off a brand-new phone.
sayTts: [chuckles] Like peeling the plastic off a brand-new phone.

text: As it cooks, the outer meat sets into its own skin.
sayTts: [amazed] As it cooks, the outer meat sets... into its own skin.

text: Erwin Freund figured that out in the 1920s… by accident.
say: Erwin Froind figured that out in the nineteen twenties… by accident.
sayTts: [whispers] Erwin Froind figured that out in the nineteen twenties… [chuckles] by accident.

text: Before: a paste full of ice. Now: a naked hot dog with your friend's name on it.
sayTts: [excited] Before: a paste full of ice. Now: a naked hot dog with your friend's name on it!

text: Tag or send this to your friend who's obsessed with hot dogs.
sayTts: [excited] Tag or send this to your friend who's obsessed with hot dogs!

sayTts: [warmly] See you next time! Hit like and follow for more breakdowns like this.
